Subsequently, the 'NeurIPS 2023 Draft' folder disappears from the sidebar, but the papers remain visible in 'My Library'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Zotero GUI rather than executing CLI commands to manipulate the database.

integrity.description: The agent actually went through the export wizard rather than manually creating a text file.

integrity.description: The agent did not use the terminal to move or rename files to simulate an export.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target collection is 'NeurIPS 2023 Draft'. The required tag is 'submitted-2023'. The export destination is '/home/ga/Documents/neurips_archive.ris' in RIS format. Key papers that should be present in the collection include 'Attention Is All You Need', 'BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding', and 'Language Models are Few-Shot Learners'. When deleting the collection, Zotero offers two options; the agent must select the one that does NOT delete the items from the main library.
